metadata.scenario: A patient calls to add an extra physical therapy session this week because they have a doctor's appointment next week and want to show progress. The receptionist fits them in for Wednesday at 4 PM.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Patricia Wilson. I'm calling about my mother who needs post-surgery care after her hip replacement. Hi Patricia! I’m glad you called. When is your mother’s surgery scheduled? It's on Monday next week, and I want to ensure she has physical therapy lined up as soon as possible. Absolutely, we can help with that. How many physical therapy sessions are you looking to schedule? Ideally, I'd like to add an extra session this week to show progress before her doctor's appointment next week. That makes sense. Let me check our schedule for you. Great, thank you. I just want to make sure we can get her in as soon as possible. Yes, I understand. We can definitely fit her in for an extra session. How does Wednesday at 4 PM sound? That works! Thank you so much. Perfect! I’ll go ahead and schedule that for you. I appreciate it. Will someone call me to confirm? Yes, you'll receive a confirmation call from our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen. Okay, that sounds good. What should my mother expect during the therapy? The physical therapist will work on mobility, strength, and balance improvement tailored to her recovery needs. That sounds perfect. How much do the sessions cost? Our physical therapy sessions range from $110 to $140, depending on the specifics involved. Okay, I’ll keep that in mind. Are there other services you recommend for her recovery? Besides physical therapy, we also offer post-surgery recovery care, which could be beneficial for her home needs. I might be interested in that. Can you give me more details? Certainly! Our post-surgery recovery care is priced between $85 and $110 for 1-3 hours of specialized care. Sounds great. I’ll discuss that with my family and get back to you. That’s perfectly fine! I’ll make a note to follow up with you in a few days. Thank you, Margaret. I really appreciate all your help today. You’re very welcome, Patricia. We’re here to help. Have a great day! You too, bye! Goodbye!
